abilitywar.skill.void.skill1.desc: A void tendril drags the target in, then lands a critical punch. Slows for 1s and concusses (blurred vision).
abilitywar.skill.void.skill2.desc: Charge the void in your fist and release it: heavy damage and sends enemies flying. Concussion.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill3.desc: Teleport to the target, throw 4 punches and slam them into the ground. If the target is 3+ blocks above ground, slam immediately for the same damage.
abilitywar.skill.void.skill4.desc: Counter stance. If hit by an attack or skill (not ultimates), negate it, punch the attacker in the face and slam them down. On failure only the guard motion plays.
abilitywar.skill.void.ultimate.desc: Usable when the gauge is full. Summons a black hole that pulls everything in. Captured enemies lose 75% of max health (bosses: 10%). Players within 10 blocks see the cinematic.
abilitywar.skill.void.passive.desc: Sink into your shadow (invulnerable) and emerge from any shadow you choose: a dark spot or another creature's shadow. Press T again to emerge at the aimed shadow.

ability.abilitywar.dragon.desc: Heir of the Elder Dragon. A melee combo fighter of claws, wings and tail (hard).
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill1.desc: Dash forward and claw twice. The last hit pulls the enemy in front of you and leaves a Dragon Blood mark. Airborne enemies are slashed upward; marked enemies take an empowered last hit.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill2.desc: Spread giant wings to push nearby enemies away, then strike ahead to launch them high. Right after Dragon Claw the wings strike twice. Airborne enemies are pulled in front of you.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill3.desc: Close in instantly: right claw, left claw, tail whip, crossed-claw downstrike. Follows airborne enemies up and slams them down. Bonus hit if Dragon Claw and Wing Strike landed in a row.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.skill4.desc: Scale-armor counter stance. Negates basic attacks and skills (not ultimates), claws the attacker's face and tail-slams them into the ground. Success lets Fury chain immediately. On failure only the guard pose plays.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.ultimate.desc: Use with a full Dragon Blood gauge. An elder dragon phantom roars and pulls enemies in, you leap into the sky and its breath burns the area. Bonus damage on marked enemies, brief super armor. While transformed, usable as a finisher with any remaining gauge.
abilitywar.skill.dragon.passive.desc: Hold T with a full Dragon Blood gauge. Claws, wings, scales and glowing patterns grow, fire afterimages trail your movement, basic attacks become claw strikes and some skills are empowered. Ends when the gauge runs out.
abilitywar.ult.dragon.title: 古龍降臨
abilitywar.ult.dragon.subtitle: Advent of the Elder Dragon
ability.abilitywar.blade.desc: A combo swordsman wielding a mana-infused blade, striking through teleports and afterimages.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill1.desc: Take a draw stance, focus mana, then dash through enemies with a cut that leaves violet afterimages and lightly launches them. Applies a Mana Mark. Follows airborne enemies. Empowered right after Phantom Step.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill2.desc: An upward slash that fires a crescent wave, launching enemies high; a mana rift then tears open for bonus damage. Faster right after Demonic Draw, re-launches airborne enemies, bonus damage on marked enemies.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill3.desc: Teleport around the target slashing from the right, left, behind and front, then slam down (5 hits). Follows airborne enemies and forces them down. After Draw→Breaker the final cut explodes; marked enemies take an extra cut; use Phantom Step mid-dance to keep attacking.
abilitywar.skill.blade.skill4.desc: A mana guard stance. Negates basic attacks and skills (not ultimates), parries, teleports behind the attacker and launches them with a slash to the back. Success lets the Blade Dance chain immediately and restores mana. On failure only the guard motion plays.
abilitywar.skill.blade.ultimate.desc: Use with a full mana gauge. Raise the blade to absorb surrounding mana, leap into the sky with a giant sword and bring down a colossal slash; mana explosions erupt along its path. Pulls nearby enemies in, bonus damage on marked enemies, super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.blade.passive.desc: Become an afterimage and teleport where you look (or behind the aimed enemy). The blade afterimage left behind explodes shortly after. Right after Demonic Draw it goes behind that enemy, during the Blade Dance it continues the attack, and the next Demonic Draw is empowered.
abilitywar.ult.blade.title: 천지개벽
abilitywar.ult.blade.subtitle: HEAVEN SPLITTER
ability.abilitywar.blood.desc: A vampiric predator that pays with its own blood, stacking bleed on enemies and draining it back.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill1.desc: Shoot a blood thread from your fingertips into an enemy, reel yourself in and rip them with both claws (follows airborne enemies into the air). Applies 1 Bleed. Enemies with 3+ Bleed have all of it burst for bonus damage. Right after Bat Swarm the enemy is pulled too and the rip hits harder.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill2.desc: Slit your wrist (costs 2 HP) and strike the ground: three waves of blood spikes erupt forward and launch enemies high. Right after Crimson Snare they erupt right under that enemy and re-launch airborne enemies. Bonus damage per Bleed stack.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill3.desc: Lunge at an enemy like a bat, claw four times (each eats a Bleed stack for bonus damage), grab them and bite to drain health, then slam them down. Airborne enemies are driven into the ground. After Snare→Spikes the drain is doubled and the final blow explodes in blood.
abilitywar.skill.blood.skill4.desc: Wrap yourself in a membrane of blood. Blocking a basic attack or skill (not ultimates) bursts the veil: spikes impale the attacker from below and their blood is drained. Success lets Sanguine Frenzy chain immediately and fills the gauge. On failure the veil dissolves.
abilitywar.skill.blood.ultimate.desc: Use with a full gauge. The sky turns red and a blood moon rises. Spread bat wings, rise up, bind up to 12 nearby enemies with blood chains and pull them in, drain them while they hang in the air, then burst them all at once. Bonus damage on bleeding enemies, super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.blood.passive.desc: Scatter into a swarm of bats and fly where you look (invulnerable), biting and bleeding enemies on the way. Right after Crimson Snare you reappear behind that enemy and your next Crimson Snare is empowered.
abilitywar.ult.blood.title: 血月滿開
abilitywar.ult.blood.subtitle: BLOOD MOON BLOOM
ability.abilitywar.cantor.desc: Buffer class. Empowers themself and teammates with hymns, binds enemies with bells and judgement light.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill1.desc: Raise the baton and bring it down to release a sound wave. Allies within 9 blocks gain Valor (+30% damage dealt, 10s); nearby enemies take damage, are pushed away and get Dissonance (-20% damage dealt). Harmony: 15s, adds Grace (healing) and stuns enemies.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill2.desc: Kneel and plant the baton to raise a dome of light (radius 5, 6s). Allies inside gain Aegis (-30% damage taken) and heal; enemies that enter are bounced out and damaged. Harmony: radius 7, 8s, double healing.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill3.desc: Point to the sky and a giant bell falls on the aimed enemy (or ahead): damage, 1s stun and Dissonance, then the bell rings and grants nearby allies Haste (move speed and cooldown recovery). Harmony: the bell rings three times, damaging each time.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.skill4.desc: A counter stance behind a circle of light. Blocking a basic attack or skill (not ultimates) calls down judgement light on the attacker (damage + Silence: no skills for 2.5s) and heals nearby allies with Aegis. Success makes Anthem of Valor ready, adds a note and fills the gauge.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.ultimate.desc: Use with a full gauge. Light pours from the sky; rise with wings of light and a giant halo and sing the heavenly chorus. Every ally within 16 blocks heals 50%, is cleansed and gains empowered Valor, Aegis and Haste for 15s plus Grace; enemies are struck by judgement light, silenced and get Dissonance. Super armor while casting.
abilitywar.skill.cantor.passive.desc: Switch the always-on aura given to allies within 7 blocks: Valor -> Aegis -> Haste. The current melody shows as the halo color and the T slot color.
abilitywar.ult.cantor.title: GLORIA
abilitywar.ult.cantor.subtitle: HEAVENLY CHORUS
ability.abilitywar.warlock.desc: A necromancer who commands minions: gear up a personal skeleton and raise the souls of slain or captured mobs.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.skill1.desc: Summon your own skeleton warrior. It starts bare, but armor and weapons equipped in the Grimoire (G) stay on it (durability wears as it fights). It attacks whatever you hit. If it is already out, it is called to your side. 15s before it can return after dying.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.skill2.desc: Raise a mob from a soul in your Grimoire (half health and damage, keeps all its abilities). Souls from kills are lost when the raised mob dies; souls captured with the ultimate return after 30 minutes. Up to 6 at once; dismiss extras in G.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.skill3.desc: Channel a dark beam forward (0.7s). Taking all 6 hits deals 11 damage and knocks the target down for 2s.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.skill4.desc: Bind the aimed enemy with dark chains from the ground. It cannot move for 5 seconds.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.ultimate.desc: A giant shadow hand grabs an enemy at 50% health or less (bosses 20%) and tears out its soul. Mobs are captured into the Grimoire; players die instantly. The gauge is kept if the target is not eligible.
abilitywar.skill.warlock.passive.desc: When the warlock or a teammate kills a mob, its soul floats there for 10 seconds (players leave no soul). Press T to gather souls within 12 blocks into the Grimoire.
abilitywar.ult.warlock.title: SOUL HARVEST
abilitywar.ult.warlock.subtitle: SOUL HARVEST
abilitywar.warlock.captured_died: Captured %s fell — can be raised again in 30 minutes
abilitywar.warlock.skeleton_died: Skeleton destroyed — can be summoned again in 15s
abilitywar.warlock.no_souls: No souls in the Grimoire (kill mobs and gather with T)
abilitywar.warlock.too_many: Raised mobs at maximum (%s) — dismiss in G
abilitywar.warlock.ult_too_healthy: Only targets at %s%% health or less can be harvested
abilitywar.warlock.grimoire_full: Grimoire full — discard souls in G
abilitywar.warlock.empty2: Kill mobs and press T to gather
ability.abilitywar.angel.desc: Healer class. Basic attacks heal allies, skills grant team buffs and blessings. The ultimate gauge fills only by healing.
abilitywar.skill.angel.skill1.desc: Spread a healing wave. Every party member (same team) within 5 blocks heals 6 HP.
abilitywar.skill.angel.skill2.desc: Raise both arms to the sky: party members within 5 blocks gain Fervor (+20% attack speed), Health Boost (+4 max HP), Valor (+15% damage dealt) and Aegis (-15% damage taken) for 15 s, and heal 4 HP.
abilitywar.skill.angel.skill3.desc: Call down golden light on the aimed ally (or yourself): level 2 buffs for 20 s, stronger than Grace (+40% attack speed, +8 max HP, +30% damage, -30% damage taken), Grace regeneration, and 4 HP heal.
abilitywar.skill.angel.skill4.desc: Channel a stream of healing light into the aimed ally (or yourself) until it blooms: heal 14 HP, cleanse negative effects, strong regeneration for 5 s.
abilitywar.skill.angel.ultimate.desc: Use when the gauge is full. Rise on spread wings, draw seven magic circles in the sky and rain down heavenly beams (16 blocks, ~1.6 s). Enemies hit take 4 damage and are staggered; allies (including you) hit heal 4 HP and gain Valor and Aegis. The same target can be hit at most once every 0.35 s. The gauge only fills by healing allies.
abilitywar.skill.angel.passive.desc: Toggle flight mode / walk mode. In flight mode your wings spread and you fly freely (double-jump to take off again after landing). In walk mode your wings fold; switching drifts you down slowly.
abilitywar.ult.angel.title: HEAVENLY JUDGEMENT
abilitywar.ult.angel.subtitle: 天上審判
abilitywar.screen.first_hint: Choose your 1st class. At level 30 the Class Master can advance you to a 2nd class.
ability.abilitywar.warrior.desc: 1st class. Close-range fighter who cuts and endures. 2nd: Spellblade, Blood Fiend, Dragon Knight.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.skill1.desc: Dash 6 blocks forward, cutting enemies in the way (4 dmg). 8s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.skill2.desc: Spin and cut everything within 3.5 blocks (5 dmg, knockback). 10s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.skill3.desc: Valor for party within 8 blocks (8s, +15% damage); Resistance for yourself. 20s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.skill4.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.ultimate.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.warrior.passive.desc: Catch your breath: heal 30% max health + Regeneration. 30s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.mage.skill1.desc: Hurl a fireball that explodes in 2.5 blocks (6 dmg + fire). 6s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.mage.skill2.desc: Slam the ground and freeze everything within 5 blocks (4 dmg + Slowness II 3s). 12s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.mage.skill3.desc: Teleport 8 blocks where you look. 8s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.mage.skill4.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.mage.ultimate.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
ability.abilitywar.tank.desc: 1st class. Shield fighter who draws and absorbs attacks. 2nd: Guardian.
abilitywar.skill.tank.skill1.desc: Mobs within 10 blocks target you; enemy players get Dissonance (-20% damage). Resistance for 5s. 12s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.tank.skill2.desc: Charge behind your shield; enemies hit are stunned for 1s. 9s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.tank.skill3.desc: Resistance II + absorption + unstoppable for 5s. 18s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.tank.skill4.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.tank.ultimate.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
ability.abilitywar.healer.desc: 1st class. Support who heals teammates (basic attack heals the ally you look at). 2nd: Angel, Cantor.
abilitywar.skill.healer.skill1.desc: Heal the ally you look at (or yourself) for 6. 6s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.healer.skill2.desc: Cleanse party within 5 blocks and heal 3. 12s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.healer.skill3.desc: Aegis for party within 6 blocks (8s, less damage taken). 16s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.healer.skill4.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.healer.ultimate.desc: Unlocks after your 2nd class advancement. Level up and visit the Class Master.
abilitywar.skill.healer.passive.desc: Regeneration for party within 6 blocks for 6s. 25s cooldown.
ability.abilitywar.guardian.desc: Tank 2nd class. Protects the party with a great shield. Ultimate charges fastest from damage taken or blocked.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.skill1.desc: Taunt enemies within 12 blocks; gain Resistance + Absorption II. 12s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.skill2.desc: Rush 7 blocks pushing enemies on your shield, then stun them 1.5s (5 dmg). 10s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.skill3.desc: Plant your shield: a radius-5 dome for 6s. Allies inside take 30% less damage, enemies are slowed. 22s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.skill4.desc: Leap and slam: 7 dmg in radius 4, knock up and slow. 14s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.ultimate.desc: A giant shield falls from the sky: allies within 10 blocks take 60% less damage for 10s. Enemies within 12 are pulled in and taunted.
abilitywar.skill.guardian.passive.desc: Toggle. While on, you take 40% of damage dealt to teammates within 8 blocks. You take 25% less damage but move 15% slower.
abilitywar.ult.guardian.title: FORTRESS
abilitywar.ult.guardian.subtitle: Unbreakable Wall
rpg.abilitywar.stat.dex.desc: More critical hits and a bit more speed.
rpg.abilitywar.level_up: Level up! Level %s (+%s stat points, press [K])
rpg.abilitywar.job_ready: You can now take your 2nd class! Visit the Class Master.
rpg.abilitywar.err.wrong_class: This quest belongs to another 1st class.
rpg.abilitywar.err.has_quest: You already have an advancement quest.
rpg.abilitywar.err.far: Get closer to the Class Master.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_void: The One Who Gazed Into the Void
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_void.desc: They say the eyes of Endermen reflect the void. Defeat Endermen and gather ender pearls to prove you can wield it.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_warlock.desc: To command the dead, first know death. Slay the undead and offer their bones.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_blade.desc: Only those who survive countless battles can bind mana to steel. Defeat hostile mobs and gather iron to forge your blade.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_blood.desc: The fiend awakens at night. Hunt hostile mobs after dark and gather spider eyes.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_dragon.desc: To awaken dragon blood, endure the flame. Defeat Blazes and gather blaze rods.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_guardian.desc: A Guardian takes the blows meant for others. Endure damage (taken or blocked) and bring iron blocks to forge your shield.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_angel.desc: Wings are granted to those who save many lives. Restore health and gather feathers.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.job_cantor.desc: A Cantor's song empowers allies. Buff teammates and bring note blocks.
rpg.abilitywar.screen.stats_hint: 3 points per level (+2 every 10 levels) · [%s] to close

rpg.abilitywar.guide.ready: Done! Return to the Class Master to advance.

rpg.abilitywar.guide.visit: Visit the Class Master to get your quest.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.no_class: You have not chosen a path yet. Pick a class first.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.advanced: You walk the path of the %s. At level %s I can grant you a greater name.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.ready: You finished "%s"! Show me the proof and I will grant you new power.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.progress: "%s" is not finished yet. Come back when you are done.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.level: You are not ready. Come back at level %s.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.choose.warrior: Warrior, what do you seek at the edge of the blade? Mana, blood, or dragonfire? Choose one.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.choose.mage: Mage, deep magic splits in two. Will you wield the void, or command death?
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.choose.tank: Tank, are you ready to be the shield of your allies? The Guardian's path is hard.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.choose.healer: Healer, will you earn wings to save from the sky, or sing to empower allies?
rpg.abilitywar.tree.sub: 1st → Class Master quest → 2nd → 3rd "Grand" (Lv 60 + boss) · King's quest → Paladin
rpg.abilitywar.tree.hint: Advance at the Class Master · [%s] to close
rpg.abilitywar.tree.hint_admin: Click a class to switch · [%s] to close
rpg.abilitywar.err.other_giver: Turn this quest in to someone else.
rpg.abilitywar.guide.grand_done: 3rd class awakened! You are at your peak.
rpg.abilitywar.guide.grand_level: Reach level %s for the 3rd class quest (now %s)
rpg.abilitywar.guide.grand_visit: Visit the Class Master for your 3rd class quest.
rpg.abilitywar.tree.grand_desc: 3rd class: +30% damage, -10% damage taken, -15% cooldowns, +20% ult charge, +30% healing & buffs, +6 max health, golden aura
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.grand: %s, the final trial awaits. Slay a boss and bring proof, and you shall be Grand.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.grand_done: %s... I have nothing more to teach. May your name become legend.
rpg.abilitywar.npc.say.special: You are a knight of the King. Your trials come from His Majesty.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_blade.desc: Where blade and mana become one. Cut down hordes and a boss, then reforge your sword with diamonds.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_blood.desc: Master the hunger. Hunt every night and drink a boss's blood. Ghast tears are your proof.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_dragon.desc: Only those born of flame become Elder. Hunt blazes and fell a boss.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_void.desc: See the end of the void. Hunt endermen, fell a boss, and gather eyes of ender.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_warlock.desc: Rule an army of the dead. Slay the undead and reap a boss's soul.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_guardian.desc: Stand after taking thousands of blows for your allies. Even a boss's.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_angel.desc: Save countless lives. Keep allies alive even against a boss.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_cantor.desc: Lead your allies with song. Sing the hymn that fells a boss.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.grand_paladin.desc: Drive back the darkness that threatens the realm. Purge the undead and fell two bosses.
rpg.abilitywar.quest.king_paladin.desc: To be knighted you must face the darkness. Slay the undead, defeat a boss, and offer gold blocks to the King.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.offer: Brave one, the realm needs holy knights. Will you take my oath and become a Paladin?
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.level: I see your courage. But you must be level %s to be my knight.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.wrong_class: Only warriors, tanks and healers may become Paladins.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.paladin: My Paladin, guard the realm. At level %s I will tell you the secret of the holy sword.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.grand: The time has come, Paladin. Take up the trial of the holy sword.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.grand_done: Grand Paladin, with you the realm shall never fall.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.ready: You completed "%s"! Kneel, and be knighted.
rpg.abilitywar.king.say.progress: "%s" is not yet done. The realm trusts you.
ability.abilitywar.paladin.desc: Special class from the King's quest (warrior, tank, healer). Fights with a holy sword, shields and heals allies. +50% vs undead.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.skill1.desc: Leap and drive your holy sword down: 6 dmg in radius 3, slow, pillar of light. 8s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.skill2.desc: Cleanse party within 6 blocks and grant Absorption II + Aegis for 8s. 16s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.skill3.desc: Plant your sword: a radius-5 sanctum for 6s. Enemies take 1.5 every 0.5s (undead x2), allies heal. 18s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.skill4.desc: Bind an enemy within 14 blocks: 2.5s root, 4 dmg, pulled toward you. 12s cooldown.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.ultimate.desc: Cinematic: a colossal holy sword falls from the sky. 18 dmg in radius 7 + 2s stun, allies within 10 heal 40% + Resistance II, the sword stays as an 8s sanctum.
abilitywar.skill.paladin.passive.desc: Toggle. Allies within 8 blocks take 12% less damage; your hits heal allies within 6 a little.
abilitywar.ult.paladin.title: HOLY SWORD
abilitywar.ult.paladin.subtitle: Descent of the Holy Sword

guild.abilitywar.quest.g_f1.desc: Defeat the zombies that wander near town at night.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_f2.desc: Spiders are multiplying in the fields. Clear them out.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_e1.desc: Defeat the skeleton archers on the roads.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_e2.desc: Deal with the creepers blowing up the fields.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_d1.desc: Defeat undead that rise at night.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_c3.desc: Banish the wisps that lure travelers.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_c4.desc: Deliver gold to the royal treasury.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_a1.desc: Defeat wither skeletons in a Nether fortress.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_a3.desc: Shoot down ghasts in the Nether.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_a4.desc: The mages' tower needs ender pearls.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_s2.desc: Defeat the Fallen King of the ruined fortress.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_s3.desc: Defeat a great number of hostile mobs.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_s4.desc: Defeat the witch of the Frost Temple.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_ss2.desc: Defeat the Ancient Wyvern of the roost.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_ss3.desc: Defeat the Ember Colossus of the altar.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_ss4.desc: The legendary smith needs netherite scrap.
guild.abilitywar.quest.g_sss4.desc: Defeat the Warden of the ancient city.
item.abilitywar.enhance_stone.desc: Used by blacksmiths to enhance gear. From monsters, bosses, guild quests and the blacksmith shop
item.abilitywar.protection_scroll.desc: Keeps the enhancement level from dropping when a +10 or higher enhancement fails (uses 1)
shop.abilitywar.say.apothecary: Welcome, adventurer! Nothing beats a health potion for those wounds. Take what you need.

item.abilitywar.abyss_crystal.desc: Found in the Abyss Tower. Used to awaken +15 gear at a blacksmith.
item.abilitywar.dragon_heart.desc: The still-beating heart of the Ender Dragon. Needed for awakening from ★3.
smith.abilitywar.awaken_fail: Failure keeps the stars (materials are used)
tower.abilitywar.title: Abyss Tower
tower.abilitywar.say: An endless tower into the abyss. Monsters grow stronger with every floor, and a boss waits every 5 floors. How high can you go?
tower.abilitywar.party: %s party members enter together (within 32 blocks, level 40+)
tower.abilitywar.solo: Entering alone (party members within 32 blocks join you)
tower.abilitywar.rule1: Each floor gives G, XP and enhance stones; boss floors give Abyss Crystals (awakening). Bonus for every first 10-floor clear.
tower.abilitywar.rule2: You can restart from the floor after any 10 you cleared (11, 21, 31 …).
tower.abilitywar.rule3: Dying in the tower keeps your items. Leave with /aw tower leave
tower.abilitywar.enter: Entering the Abyss Tower at floor %s… (leave: /aw tower leave)
tower.abilitywar.bar.break: Next floor (%s) in %ss · leave: /aw tower leave
tower.abilitywar.milestone: ★ First clear of floor %s! (G, Abyss Crystals, Protection Scroll, Boss Soul)
tower.abilitywar.broadcast: %s cleared Abyss Tower floor %s for the first time!
tower.abilitywar.summary: This run: up to floor %s · best: floor %s
tower.abilitywar.err.level_member: Your level is too low to join this run (level %s).
tower.abilitywar.err.already: You are already in the tower.
tower.abilitywar.err.full: The tower is full right now. Try again later.
tower.abilitywar.err.closed: The Abyss Tower is not available.
boss.abilitywar.ender_dragon.appeared: ⚠ The Ender Dragon, Dragon of the End, awakens!
boss.abilitywar.ender_dragon.rage1: The Ender Dragon roars in fury!
boss.abilitywar.ender_dragon.rage2: The Ender Dragon summons its last strength!
mob.abilitywar.thief.stole: A thief stole %s G and ran! Catch and defeat it to get it back.
region.abilitywar.dragon_nest.sub: Extreme danger · Boss: The Dragon King · Drakes

item.abilitywar.bandit_seal.desc: A seal carried by bandits and thieves. Infinity ascension material.

item.abilitywar.cult_sigil.desc: A black sigil carried by cultists. refining material.

item.abilitywar.lord_emblem.desc: Emblem of a goblin lord or orc warlord. Transcendence material.

smith.abilitywar.ascend_note.transcend: Stats carry over; enhance again from +1+ to +99+. Awakening ★ stays.
smith.abilitywar.ascend_note.refine: Stats carry over; enhance again from Refined +1 to +99.
smith.abilitywar.ascend_note.infinity: Becomes Infinity grade gear of the same kind (+0, stronger than Refined +99). Awakening ★ stays.
gear.abilitywar.ui.next_transcend: At +99 a blacksmith can Transcend+ it.
gear.abilitywar.ui.next_refine: At +99+ a blacksmith can Refine it.
gear.abilitywar.ui.next_infinity: At Refined +99 it can ascend to Infinity gear.
gear.abilitywar.ui.beyond_hint: ? gear can be enhanced to +99 (from +15, failures keep the level).
smith.abilitywar.ascend_note.infinity_av: Becomes real Avaritia Infinity gear: blades → Sword of the Cosmos, axe → Nature's Ruin, hammer → World Breaker, spear → trident, staff → Longbow of the Heavens, armor → Infinity armor.
gear.abilitywar.ui.next_infinity_avariti: At Refined +99 it can ascend to Avaritia Infinity gear.
